real-writer span whose head holds a listed non-blob path; assert the warn

summary: snapshotReverted's per-path skip states the omitted path instead of dropping it silently
acceptance: A path the span's listing names and the head cannot hand back as a blob leaves a warn naming it; the rest of the snapshot and the revert are unchanged.
tests: snapshotReverted warns and names a listed path it could not read at the span head
notes: Only silent arm left on the revert path after A-FAILED-PROSE-SNAPSHOT-SAYS-SO: the whole-artifact catch speaks, one missing file does not, while diffStat still advertises the path. Reachability measured this tick and cheaper than the note put it — no git race needed: a gitlink in the span is named by --diff-filter=d and readFileAtRef returns null on a non-blob row (src/git.ts:793), so the fixture is a real span, not a mock.
